zh: 侧栏条目的固定状态改用 DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 自带的固定列表，编辑侧栏对话框、行上的取消固定按钮与 More 菜单共用一份状态，取消固定的条目仍会跨重启保存
en: Sidebar entries now share the pin list DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 keeps, so the Edit sidebar dialog, the unpin button on each row and the More menu act on one state, and the entries taken off are still stored across restarts
